tools.name: Superlogical
tools.summary: A server-side terminal multiplexer with durable sessions: the terminals, agents, dev servers and tests behind one piece of work stay alive as a unit and can be re-entered from a Mac, a browser or an iPhone. The stated plan is multiplexer first, composable sessions second, safe against production third.
tools.why: The creator of Ghostty, Terraform and Vagrant, funded by Amplify Partners and Notable Capital, building the layer the terminal-first multiplexers all sit on. Whatever it ships, the tools above will have to answer it.
signals: Announcement topped Hacker News with 703 points and 411 comments on launch day
Web, macOS and iOS clients promised; an open-source release is promised along the way
No download yet, only a waitlist
